title: DEPHYRIER Gongbaek Dansunhi (Slack Search)
style: search-syntax anthem, 94 bpm, English Korean romanization French trilingual, deadpan slack-search recital, terminal core, filter-modifier chant, DEPHYRIER signature, search-discipline groove, no-boolean reminder
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Slack search no boolean operators allowed
AND OR NOT will not work in the cloud
Space separated terms implicit AND
In colon channel modifier filter the band

[Pre-Chorus — Korean romanization]
Seurek geomsaek noksaek dansunhada
Gongbaek hana ihaehago jjarpge gada
(Slack search green simple / One blank understand and go briefly)

[Chorus — trilingual]
In channel from user has file has link
Slack syntax discipline keeps the brink
Gongbaek dansunhi simple space
The filter modifiers find the place

[Verse 2 — English]
From at username before colon date
After colon date during month state
Has colon pin has colon link has colon file
Start broad add modifiers narrow the trial

[Bridge — Korean romanization]
Komma upsi gonggi banghyang piltter
DEPHYRIER Seurek munbeop biteo
(No comma space direction filter / DEPHYRIER Slack grammar bitter)

[Outro — trilingual]
In channel from user has file has link
The filter discipline holds the sync
